items.title: Sudan: US proposes expanding UN arms embargo
items.description: The US has called for a UN arms embargo for Darfur to be broadened to the whole of Sudan. The change would require Security Council approval, with Russia warning it would hurt the Sudanese army.

items.title: China warns it will safeguard its interests after US widens sanctions against Iran
items.description: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.
